analysis: First, analyze context: The method internal_write copies data from src into out_buffer, and when out_buffer_pos reaches BUFF_SIZE, it calls bo.write(out_buffer, 0, BUFF_SIZE). out_buffer is an instance variable assumed to be a byte array of size BUFF_SIZE. No validation is performed on out_buffer or bo before the call. Then analyze exception types and their throwing conditions: NullPointerException is thrown if b is null; out_buffer is not checked for null, so not avoided. IndexOutOfBoundsException is thrown if off is negative, len is negative, or off+len is greater than b.length; here off=0, len=BUFF_SIZE, and out_buffer is of length BUFF_SIZE, so condition not met; avoided by design. IOException is thrown if an I/O error occurs, e.g., the stream is closed; no check is made for bo being open, so not avoided.
answer: NullPointerException: not avoided. IndexOutOfBoundsException: avoided. IOException: not avoided.
remark: NullPointerException can occur if out_buffer is null, which is not checked before calling write. IOException can occur if bo is closed or another I/O error arises, as there is no validation of stream state before the call. IndexOutOfBoundsException is avoided because the call uses off=0 and len=BUFF_SIZE, and out_buffer is assumed to have at least BUFF_SIZE elements, so the condition for IndexOutOfBoundsException is not met.
